meta.purpose: Every outside source behind the rules, the triage rows and the diagnosis cards, listed once. Rules entries point here by id through their `sources` array (FR-KNOW-04). docs/references.md is generated from this file (FR-KNOW-06): run `npm run references`.

fields.id: lower-case slug, unique; what a `sources` array names
fields.title: the source's own title
fields.region: where the guidance applies, e.g. West Africa
fields.licence: the licence as the source states it, e.g. CC BY-SA 4.0; `unknown` or `not stated` when it has none
fields.bundled: true only if a copy ships inside the app; false means link only
fields.covers: the rules ids it speaks to: diagnosis card ids, active ingredients, gate ids
fields.attribution: required when bundled under a CC BY licence (FR-KNOW-01): the credit line shown with it

licence_rules: FR-KNOW-00: a bundled item records its source, licence and URL; an item with no licence recorded is link only.
FR-KNOW-01: a CC BY-SA item we adapt ships with its attribution and the same licence.
FR-KNOW-02: an item whose licence carries NC (non-commercial) is never bundled. The test suite fails if one is.
FR-KNOW-03: our own words, written from reading a source, are DouValue's content, attributed as 'summarised from [source]'.
